jobs.prompt: Port and fix the 'auto-approve windows' feature on top of the current main (the orchestrator-mode guard #292 has since been rewritten, so do not copy the old integration diff blindly). Reference files, read-only: coordination/review/aa-ref/auto-approve-policy.mjs (the old policy module), auto-approve.test.mjs, auto-approve.md, and integration.diff (how the old branch hooked into tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/handbuild-guard.mjs, tools/shell-writes.mjs and tools/self-approval.mjs). Goal: the owner's standing policy can auto-approve hand-build windows for swarm-admin work (swarm/* and feat/* branches, git add/commit/push of swarm-produced files, branch switch) without waiting for the owner, because an idle project waited 18 hours on one window approval. An Opus static security review of the old branch said FAIL; fix all of these in the new version and add a test for each in tests/auto-approve.test.mjs: (1) pushes go to ANY configured remote today: allow push only to the remote named origin whose URL is the project's own repository, and only of the current swarm/* or feat/* branch to the same-named remote branch, never to main, master or a protected branch, never --force or --delete or a refspec with a colon or plus; (2) bare 'git push' and upstream/branch config (push.default, the per-branch remote setting, set-upstream-to, and the -u flag) can change what a push does: refuse bare git push, refuse any git config or -c override, resolve the target explicitly; (3) branch race: the branch checked when the window is granted can change before the command runs: bind the approval to the branch name and the HEAD commit at grant time and re-check both at execution; (4) git switch and git checkout accept paths and carry a dirty tree: allow only 'git switch BRANCH' or 'git switch -c BRANCH' with a branch under the allowed prefixes on a clean tree, refuse checkout with paths, '--', --force, --discard-changes, --merge, --detach and any dirty-tree switch; (5) 'git worktree remove --force' and 'git worktree prune' must not be auto-approved; plain 'git worktree remove PATH' only for a worktree under ~/.project-swarm-scratch and clean; (6) refuse 'git commit --amend', '-C', '-c', '--reuse-message', '--no-verify' and '--allow-empty-message' forms; (7) no cumulative limit: add a per-window and per-day cap on the number of auto-approved actions and total changed files (defaults 20 actions per window, 100 per day, configurable in the approval policy), after which the window falls back to the owner (and sends the phone notification path if present); (8) the auto-approve stats and log files must be protected from writes by the session (add them to the protected-write list in the guard) and every auto-approval must be logged with the command, branch, HEAD and the rule that matched. Keep every existing guard and approval test passing (the orchestrator-mode, handbuild and guard tests, the self-approval tests, the policy tests). Put the policy in tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs, the docs in docs/auto-approve.md, and make the guard consult it through one small hook in tools/handbuild.mjs; the orchestrator-mode allowlist in tools/shell-writes.mjs must NOT gain any commit, push or switch ability (orchestrator mode stays read-only: auto-approve applies to the separate hand-build admin path only; state this in the docs). Do not copy the reference files into the output unchanged: delete coordination/review/aa-ref from the outputs (it is a temp folder, leave it untouched).
